crossRefs.note: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.
They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through…
They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they…
But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

translations.web: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
translations.bsb: At this, they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped their grasp.
translations.kjv: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
translations.asv: They sought again to take him: and he went forth out of their hand.
